why: Fix round after the review of the memory restart (ticket 1046), in next/, one agent writing the laws and the code (0177). Both blockers fixed. One: each signal now goes out inside one step on the life state (local-dev.ts lifeCell.step, under one lock): the replacing fold for SIGTERM and the killed fold for SIGKILL, each sent only when the fold moved the state for that very pid, with its fact written first; no exit, stop or start is folded in between. The replacing and killed Msgs carry the pid and the fold refuses a mismatch; the pid is Pid, a whole number above zero, in the state and at Alchemy's start event; ESRCH on either signal is already gone. Two: the OTP table gets rows for the bounded stop and the restarting child. The four review findings are fixed with their laws, the walk restriction is lifted, the call comment says what holds, and two open rows are saved.
note: Ran, Node 26.13.0, TYPESAFE_API_KEY unset, one file at a time: DevLife.laws 6 of 6; local-dev.laws 3 of 3 (L5, L6, L12); dev.laws.integration 5 of 5 (L7, L8, L13 and the two older laws) at fast and full depth; dev-control.laws.integration 3 of 3 at fast and full depth; local-dev.integration 8 of 8; dev-secrets 3 of 3; dev-errors 8 of 8; watch 4 of 4; all 14 settings test files; the app's settings and settings-generated. pnpm settings:generate changed nothing. pnpm format, pnpm lint, the ratchet (exit 0, no list row) and one whole pnpm typecheck pass. A probe of the dev-control walk saw 4 memory kills while a replacement was pending at full depth and none at fast depth. L5 and L6 changed on purpose: L5 now requires no SIGKILL once an exit is folded and each signal sent while the state names the pid; L6 used to require a SIGKILL to a process that ended in the gap, which was the bug, and now holds that signal treats ESRCH as gone for both signals and any other refusal as a defect; L12 is new. The laws call this round's new shape, so each plant marked today's rebuilds today's behavior on that shape. The memory stand-in moved to apps/fabrika/src/rss.fixture.ts, not rss.test-support.ts, since code-graph 0.15.0 reads only a fixture name as test support for a plain function (finding 2026-11-10-f50205).
